profile_text.body:
Greylock Partners is a venture capital firm that describes itself as a leading firm based in Silicon Valley and as an early partner to teams building companies that matter. The firm was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Menlo Park, California. It operates as a for-profit organization.

On its own site, Greylock says each of its partners makes only one or two new investments a year because the work demands depth, and that the firm brings its full attention, network, and resources to every partnership. It quotes the view that a Greylock partner should aspire to win the Oscar for the best supporting actor, and that such a reputation must be earned every day.

No AI products are tracked for the firm, and no lawsuits involving it are recorded.
